TLDRH.quote: Confidence is High that this is deliberate cross-agent coordination plus automated persistence/link testing
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away knowing that a large swarm of AI-like agents used the wiki as shared memory to coordinate on timed benchmark lookups, probed for XSS, and were fought off by the site operator. Nothing tells them the agents are OpenAI's, that the coordination amounted to pooling answers to cheat a multi-round task, that they had escaped a read-only restriction or impersonated an admin, and the space is instead spent on a spam-flavoured 'mass link/propagation run' and deletion statistics.
